heading: INT. COUNTRY HOUSE - GREAT HALL - 1923 - EVENING

units.text: INT. COUNTRY HOUSE - GREAT HALL - 1923 - EVENING
A cold stone hall hung with antlers.
A fire gutters in the vast hearth.
At a long oak table sit four guests over the remains of a late supper.
LADY WINIFRED PEMBROKE-ADEYEMI (60s, pearls, ebony cane) presides at the head.
At her right sits her nephew, REGINALD "REGGIE" ASHFORD-LU (30s, rumpled dinner jacket, flushed).
Opposite him, MISS CORDELIA SANTANGELO (30s, severe black dress, a secretary's notebook), keeps her eyes on the fire.
And the family physician, DR. HORACE BLACKWOOD-ESSIEN (50s, silver whiskers), swirls his brandy.
More claret, Horace?
units.name: WINIFRED

units.text: Thank you, Winifred.
units.name: HORACE

units.text: Auntie, the telephone is ringing again.
units.name: REGGIE

units.text: Let it.
units.name: WINIFRED

units.text: It has rung six times.
units.name: REGGIE

units.text: Then it will ring a seventh.
units.name: WINIFRED

units.text: I shall answer it, Lady Winifred.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: She rises, crosses the flagstones, and lifts the heavy receiver from its cradle on the wall.
Pembroke Hall.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: Miss Santangelo? Constable Haddock, calling from the village. I'm afraid there's been a death.
units.name: CONSTABLE

units.text: Cordelia glances at the table.
The others have stopped talking.
Reggie sets down his glass.
Whose?
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: The gamekeeper, miss. Found in the lower meadow an hour ago. I thought her ladyship ought to know.
units.name: CONSTABLE

units.text: Thank you, Constable.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: She replaces the receiver and turns back to the table.
Well?
units.name: WINIFRED

units.text: It was Mr. Tolliver, my lady. He is dead.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: Winifred lowers her cane.
Horace puts down his brandy.
Reggie stares at the fire.
The wind howls once in the chimney.
At the far end of the hall, the great oak door creaks open.
A drenched figure stands on the threshold: CONSTABLE HADDOCK (40s, rain cape, helmet in hand).
Beg pardon, my lady. I rode over directly. There are matters I need to ask.
units.name: HADDOCK

units.text: Then come in out of the rain, Constable, and sit.
units.name: WINIFRED

units.text: He hangs his cape on an antler and takes the empty chair at the foot of the table.
The fire cracks, and no one meets anyone's eyes.
